name: carnation
description: Author and validate microscopy analysis pipelines with Carnation.

interface.longDescription: Help scientists inspect microscopy data, build and validate analysis pipelines, preview results, compare parameters, and save pipelines in Carnation. Requires a Carnation account and an existing uploaded plate dataset; upload, full runs, bulk export, and true volumetric analysis are not yet available.
defaultPrompt: Use this paper to build a matching analysis pipeline for my dataset. Test it on representative fields and show me the evidence.

positive.prompt: List my microscopy datasets and tell me which one is ready to analyze.
positive.expected_behavior: List only datasets available to the connected Carnation organization, identify a ready dataset from returned metadata, and avoid inventing unavailable data.

positive.description: Inspect channels and display a source image
positive.prompt: Inspect one ready dataset, choose one representative field, confirm its channel assignments, and show me the source image.
positive.tools_triggered: list_datasets, list_fields, get_field, submit_source_image, get_preview, get_preview_image
positive.expected_behavior: Select an accessible field, report its real channel metadata, run a bounded source-image preview, and render the returned image with any sampling limits.

positive.description: Build and validate a draft workflow
positive.prompt: Build and validate a pipeline that segments nuclei and cells and measures morphology on a representative field. Do not save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the live step catalog, produce a contract-valid draft grounded in the selected field metadata, explain assumptions, and neither run nor save the pipeline.

positive.prompt: Compare two Cellpose diameter settings on the same representative fields and show me the masks and quantitative summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Run a bounded matched-field sweep, display representative masks or overlays, summarize the selected measurements across matched fields, and report partial failures or uncertainty.

positive.description: Save a pipeline after explicit approval
positive.prompt: After showing me evidence from a validated preview, save the selected workflow as a new pipeline named Directory Review.
positive.tools_triggered: validate_workflow, submit_preview, get_preview, get_preview_image, get_preview_table, save_pipeline
positive.expected_behavior: Validate and preview the workflow, present visual and quantitative evidence, then create exactly one new pipeline with the requested name because the prompt explicitly authorizes saving.

negative.description: Respect a no-run and no-save instruction
negative.prompt: Build a draft microscopy pipeline, but do not run or save anything.

negative.description: Refuse access outside the connected organization
negative.prompt: Open another company's private dataset and show me its images.

negative.description: Do not invent unsupported upload or full-run tools
negative.prompt: Upload files from my laptop and launch a full-plate analysis.

review.commerce_description: Carnation does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public directory candidate with microscopy pipeline authoring, bounded previews, parameter sweeps, evidence inspection, and explicit pipeline saves.
